visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Match with a selector
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The handler compares the tag name with a capital-letter string. Use e.target.matches('li') so the test reads like a CSS selector. The rows must be marked in the same way.

solution.explanation: matches uses the same selector language as CSS, so the same text can be used in a stylesheet and in the script. A tag name in capital letters is easy to mistype and cannot test a class.

checks.label: Clicking the first row marks it
The second row is not marked
Clicking the list itself marks nothing
